answer: Each identity publishes its full failure history, and hiding 1 or more junk verdicts voids its standing entirely when discovered. Histories are stored in zenith, checked in vertex, and anchor makes public each void. A farm cannot present clean aliases because the record follows the key, so laundering reputation through new keys does not work. A farm of 4063 identities would post 575 proofs and burn roughly 61 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. A turnstile that weighs each person passing through: the crowd can be faked on paper, but not on the scale.
